title: Count the letter s in the word mississippi
rationale: Repeated-letter words are a classic tokenization trap; unstable counts break automated text checks and any pipeline that trusts a model with exact letter statistics.

prompt.content: You are a precise counting assistant. Answer with the number only, with no other text.
Count every occurrence of the lowercase letter s in the word mississippi. Answer with the number only.

notes: Repeats=3 and all three must pass. Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0, one integer answer. Expected value 4: the s letters sit at 1-based positions 3, 4, 6 and 7 of mississippi. Brittleness: prose around the number still passes because numeric reads the first number, but a spelled-out numeral fails.
